notes: Company identified as Eversource Energy (NYSE: ES). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/es/financials/))

NWC construction: historical NWC is computed as total current assets minus total current liabilities using StockAnalysis balance sheet totals; this includes cash and regulatory current balances (may differ from a DCF template that excludes cash and/or uses a non-cash working capital definition). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/es/financials/balance-sheet/))

Tax rate: normalized base-case tax rate is set to 0.21 to reflect meaningful year-to-year volatility in reported effective tax rate (FY 2024 and FY 2025 were materially different). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/es/financials/))

NOL balance and NOL utilization were not located in the accessible sources used for this package; therefore both are set to null. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/es/financials/))

Peer multiples: EV/NTM fields are populated using a regulator-style cost-of-capital study’s EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA forecast multiples (not guaranteed to be exact real-time NTM). Terminal exit EBITDA multiple is the average of the selected peer EV/EBITDA forecast values from the same study. ([dor.wa.gov](https://dor.wa.gov/sites/default/files/2022-05/2022COCElectricIndustry.pdf?uid=63bd8f5c722a7))

catalysts: Rate case outcomes and regulatory decisions that affect allowed returns and cost recovery, impacting EBIT margin and cash generation. ([stocktitan.net](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ES/8-k-eversource-energy-reports-material-event-db75265cab9c.html))

Progress against the 2026–2030 capital investment plan and any adjustments to funding mix (debt/equity), influencing realized returns and balance sheet risk. ([stocktitan.net](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ES/8-k-eversource-energy-reports-material-event-db75265cab9c.html))

Execution around portfolio simplification/asset sales (continued transition to a more focused regulated platform), supporting improved earnings quality vs prior periods. ([stocktitan.net](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ES/8-k-eversource-energy-reports-material-event-db75265cab9c.html))
company_overview: Eversource Energy (NYSE: ES) is a regulated utility with core operations focused on electric transmission, electric distribution, and natural gas distribution (plus water distribution activity disclosed via segments). ([stocktitan.net](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ES/8-k-eversource-energy-reports-material-event-db75265cab9c.html))

Earnings and cash flow are driven primarily by regulated rate recovery on an asset base and the timing/approval of capital spending programs across its service territories. ([stocktitan.net](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ES/8-k-eversource-energy-reports-material-event-db75265cab9c.html))
current_context: Full-year 2025 GAAP earnings were $1.69B ($4.56 per share); management also reported 2025 non-GAAP recurring earnings of $1.77B ($4.76 per share). ([stocktitan.net](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ES/8-k-eversource-energy-reports-material-event-db75265cab9c.html))

2026 outlook: management guided 2026 earnings of $4.80–$4.95 per share and maintained a long-term EPS growth target of 5%–7% through 2030. ([stocktitan.net](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ES/8-k-eversource-energy-reports-material-event-db75265cab9c.html))

Capital plan: Eversource outlined a $26.5B investment plan for 2026–2030 (excluding Aquarion-related spending), implying sustained regulated rate-base growth support. ([stocktitan.net](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ES/8-k-eversource-energy-reports-material-event-db75265cab9c.html))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth assumes a modest, inflation-plus-rate-base style trajectory consistent with management’s 5%–7% long-term EPS growth framework (applied at the consolidated revenue/EBIT level). ([stocktitan.net](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ES/8-k-eversource-energy-reports-material-event-db75265cab9c.html))

Base-case operating profitability is anchored to the company’s historical EBIT margin (operating income/revenue) around the low-20%s, with small expansion/convergence across the forecast horizon. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/es/financials/))

Capex intensity remains elevated in line with utility capital needs; the model keeps capex as a stable share of revenue while allowing gradual stabilization in D&A intensity. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/es/financials/cash-flow-statement/))

Working capital is modeled as persistently negative (consistent with regulatory utility balance-sheet structure), with gradual normalization toward less negative levels rather than a sharp reversal. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/es/financials/balance-sheet/))
key_risks: Regulatory risk (timing, disallowances, and allowed ROE/compensation) that could pressure margins relative to the base case. ([stocktitan.net](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ES/8-k-eversource-energy-reports-material-event-db75265cab9c.html))

Higher-than-expected operating costs, storm/restoration volatility, or project cost overruns that reduce the realized spread between earnings and investment. ([stocktitan.net](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ES/8-k-eversource-energy-reports-material-event-db75265cab9c.html))

Interest-rate and credit-spread risk could raise the effective cost of capital, lowering DCF value even if operational performance matches expectations. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/es/statistics/))

valuation_summary: DCF inputs use consolidated historical statements for revenue, EBIT (operating income), depreciation & amortization, and capex, preserving internal consistency across the historical base. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/es/financials/))
